map.offline_note: Offline: works with no internet. Shows what was mapped by 25 Oct 2026 — not damage, closures or hazards.
map.canvas_label: Map. Arrow keys move, plus and minus zoom, Escape closes details. The list beside the map gives the same places as text.
map.find_label: Find an address, town, postcode or place
map.attribution: © OpenStreetMap contributors · Natural Earth · Copernicus DEM (ESA, Airbus) · CORINE Land Cover (EEA) · GeoNames · Overture Maps Foundation · NUTS © EuroGeographics
map.nearest_note: For the layers you have on. Straight-line distance, not by road.
map.area_note: The home button returns here. Saved on this device only.
map.set_home: Make the map centre my area
map.home_saved: Saved as your area on this device
map.records_note: Resource layers are records — fish, wells, mines and crops show where they were recorded or mapped, not proof of what is there now.
map.cover.building: Streets still being converted ({n} million roads and features so far) — gaps fill in automatically.
map.cover.outside: Outside the area this map details, only main roads, towns and water show.
map.cover.base_only: This download has the base map only: main roads, towns and water.
map.layers_numbers: Numbers are places in the current view.
map.group.food: Food that keeps growing (2025 crop maps)
map.layer.pond: Unnamed ponds (0.4 ha or more, year-round)
map.field.crop_area: Hectares of it in this ~600 m block
map.field.perennial_area: All tree, vine & berry hectares in block
map.caveat.mineral: Mineral record: an occurrence or past mine, not proof of recoverable ore, access or safety. Old workings can be deadly.
map.caveat.well: Well record. Most are plugged or idle; never approach an unsealed well head.
map.caveat.fish: A past stocking record — it does not confirm fish are present now.
map.caveat.boat: Facility survey data; check current access.
map.caveat.dam: Dam record. Keep away from spillways and outlets — currents and sudden releases drown people.
map.caveat.surface_water: Surface water: filter, then boil or disinfect before drinking. Skip water with green scum or discolouration (toxic algae; boiling won’t remove it).
map.caveat.crops: Satellite crop map (2025): usually right for big orchards, sometimes wrong for small ones. Trees and vines keep producing for decades but need water in dry regions and winter pruning. Private farmland — ask first.
map.caveat.pond: Small ponds are often livestock ponds with manure runoff: treat the water and cook any fish thoroughly. Small ponds can be fished out in weeks.
map.caveat.spring: Mapped spring — treat the water before drinking.
map.caveat.tap: Mapped tap; may be off in an emergency.
map.caveat.not_water: it is recorded as “{kind}”. It can hold sewage, mine waste or chemicals that treatment won’t make safe.
map.caveat.tailings: it holds mine waste, not usable water. Do not drink, swim or fish here.
